#1216 why nothing runs · mock v2

The board as it is now: no line.

A chain whose root waits on you. The number links to its card in Waiting on you.

The base is red; the tickets it holds are passed over as base-red until a green check on a new commit.

An account lock: only the banner names the limit, its reset and Lift; the line points up; the cards carry no lock mark.

A monthly spend limit names no reset: the banner says what lifts it.

Nothing conducts: the line says so and names the command.

Tickets held by different roots: the root holding most, then the rest as a count.

Only held tickets are queued: no line, because nothing is meant to run.
